liebermann.description_de: Vorlage von D und G für I As, III Eg und V. VIII Atr
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of D and G, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.laws: I As, III Eg, V Atr, VIII Atr
liebermann.notes: A common source of D and G (for III Eg meaning G 2) for I As, III Eg and V and VIII Atr, posited by Liebermann, who calls it a collector (“Sammler dg”). Cf. adg.

entries.text_de: Vorlage von D und G für I As, III Eg (wo G 2 hier gemeint wird) und V. VIII Atr. Vgl. adg.
entries.text_en: Exemplar of D and G for I As, III Eg (where G 2 is meant here) and V. VIII Atr. Cf. adg.
